subject.title: test(qa): restore session turn ordering coverage

question: Should this maintainer-labeled QA metadata change merge after its after-fix inventory output is attached and the remaining checks finish?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit human decision, and the external-PR proof gate is not met by unlinked test/check assertions alone.

options.title: Request inventory proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript or CI artifact that shows the changed coverage identifier resolving to the multi-actor scenario, then review the completed checks.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly waive the real-behavior proof requirement if the focused test is considered sufficient for this internal QA-only change.

recommendation.title: Request inventory proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript or CI artifact that shows the changed coverage identifier resolving to the multi-actor scenario, then review the completed checks.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the focused QA coverage change and is the only visible routing candidate in the supplied context.
